entries.topic: What the Dark Enlightenment / neoreaction is; spine vs overlay; label inflation; who claims or denies it

claims.text: Land's serial calls the current 'a coherent dark enlightenment' and says 'For the hardcore neo-reactionaries, democracy is not merely doomed, it is doom itself' (Part 1, 2 March 2012)

Land quotes Moldbug: 'To a neocameralist, a state is a business which owns a country'; shares, one vote per share, a board that hires and fires managers; residents as customers; Land's summary 'No voice, free exit'
Land: 'Moldbug calls it the Cathedral' — Land credits the term to Moldbug
Land quotes Moldbug: full neocameralist approach 'has never been tried'; closest equivalents Frederick the Great, Hong Kong, Singapore and Dubai

Thiel, 13 April 2009: 'I no longer believe that freedom and democracy are compatible'; women's franchise and welfare beneficiaries rendered 'capitalist democracy' an oxymoron; a follow-up linked from the essay says 'I don't think any class of people should be disenfranchised'

Finley (TechCrunch, 22 Nov 2013): neoreaction, also called dark enlightenment, starts with Yarvin/Moldbug; Cathedral as 'a meta-institution'; Yarvin: 'The design is all exit, no voice'; Land coined 'dark enlightenment'
Tablet: Yarvin's Cathedral — prestigious institutions behave 'as if they were a single organizational structure'; reports circulated in 2017 that Yarvin advised Bannon; 'Yarvin denied the rumors'

Yarvin 2008 Open Letter: would pick 'restorationist'; concedes 'reactionary'; first use of 'neoreactionary' 2008; 'I am not a White nationalist, I am not exactly allergic to the stuff' (2007); 'not an outspoken advocate for slavery, a racist, a sexist or a fascist'; Thiel 2023 Atlantic: ideas wouldn't 'work', 'interesting and powerful' historian; Vance adviser: met 'like once' (CNN 2025)

Yarvin, NYT Jan 2025: 'It's not even that democracy is bad, it's just that it's very weak'; 'Monarch is good... It's a neutral term'; friendship with Vance 'definitely overstated'; ideas spread 'through the staffers'; 'fully enlightened ... means fully disenchanted'
Vance, 2021 podcast: 'there's this guy, Curtis Yarvin, who has written about some of these things'; 'fire every single mid-level bureaucrat, every civil servant in the administrative state'
The Conversation 2022 notes neither Vance nor Masters has explicitly called for dismantling democracy

Fink-Hafner 2025 says billionaires 'particularly Elon Musk' have 'adopted Dark Enlightenment ideas' (citing a 2025 magazine article), that 'its followers damage free and fair elections', and that Bannon 'supports' it (citing a 2017 reading list)
Sarmast 2025 says Vance 'explicitly praised Yarvin's work' and reads layoffs and the Gaza 'Riviera' plan as neoreaction 'operationalized'
Andreessen's Techno-Optimist Manifesto (16 Oct 2023) lists Nick Land among its 'patron saints'
Hirschman, Exit, Voice, and Loyalty, Harvard UP 1970

Tlon, founded by Yarvin to build Urbit, received seed funding most notably from Peter Thiel; Founders Fund with Andreessen Horowitz invested $1.1 million (Pein 2018); Yarvin left Tlon in 2019 and returned as informal 'wartime CEO' in 2024
